title: Lime Green Account: ATM Access and Fee Rebates
summary: For the Lime Green Account, out-of-network ATM withdrawals are charged a $1.00 fee per domestic transaction, and foreign ATM withdrawals incur 1.5% of the amount with a $2.50 minimum. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees are rebated monthly up to a $25 cap, with no extra action needed; rebates appear as separate line items until the cap is reached.
